preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.
The number of edges m is between n-1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the valid range [1, n].
The number of provided edges matches m.
The graph formed by n nodes and the given edges is a connected cactus graph (no edge lies on more than one simple cycle).

postconditions.description: The output is an integer in the range [0, 10^9 + 6].

The output integer represents the variance of the number of connected components modulo 10^9+7, where the variance is calculated as E[X^2] - (E[X])^2 over all 2^n subsets of removed nodes, each with probability 1/2^n, and X is the number of connected components in the remaining graph.
